name: scramble-text
title: Scramble Text
description: Letters cycle through random glyphs and decode into the real text, on mount, hover or scroll into view.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. Screen readers read it as one string.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds until the last letter settles.

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds of pure noise before the first letter settles.

props.name: characters
props.description: Glyph set the letters cycle through. Whitespace is ignored.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the animation off and renders plain text.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element. A monospace font gives the steadiest look.
